title: Basic and diluted EPS — Ashford Corp.
instructions: Compute Ashford Corp.'s 2025 earnings per share. Round EPS to two decimals.

exhibits.title: Ashford Corp. — 2025 data
exhibits.content:
- Net income: **$1,250,000**. Income tax rate: 21%.
- Common stock: 400,000 shares outstanding January 1; **60,000** shares issued April 1; **20,000** treasury shares bought October 1.
- Preferred stock: 5% cumulative, nonconvertible, $2,000,000 par. No dividends were declared in 2025.
- Convertible bonds: $1,000,000 of 6% bonds outstanding all year; each $1,000 bond converts into **40** common shares. No discount or premium.
- Stock options: **30,000** options outstanding all year, exercise price **$20**; average market price of common stock **$30**.

rows.label: Weighted-average common shares for basic EPS
Income available to common shareholders
rows.explanation: 1,250,000 − 5% × 2,000,000 cumulative preferred dividends = **1,150,000** (deducted even though undeclared).

rows.label: Incremental shares from the options (treasury stock method)
After-tax interest added back for the convertible bonds
rows.explanation: 6% × 1,000,000 × (1 − 21%) = **47,400**; 47,400 ÷ 40,000 shares = 1.185 per share, below basic EPS, so dilutive.
